notes.title: Daily Deals Update! 🌊
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=buTzx7D0SkE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Hi Aquatic Store fans! 😌🐠[/h2]

[h3]To celebrate the sale, we have great news for you,  a new update - Daily Deals! 🐟[/h3]

💠[b]New game mechanic added: Daily promotions![/b] Every day, different items are on sale, one day it might be freshwater fish, another day corals, and another day filters, and so on. You will earn extra money for every item sold on sale. Juggle your inventory as you prepare for the next day to earn even more and make your business more prosperous 🐠💸🤑💰

💠The restock room has been expanded with more items to purchase

💠The display of icons for adding to favorites, item names, and reward windows has been improved in all resolutions (especially very small or very large resolutions), so now things are where they should be

💠Stamps collected from the inspector have been changed to green to associate them with the positive completion of a task

💠Fixed a bug that in rare cases blocked the progress of the tutorial when one of the fish died and it was not possible to meet the parameters in the aquarium

⤵️⤵️⤵️

[b]How to contact us with bugs?
Do it via discord 📢[/b]
https://discord.gg/76N77uHWkc

[b]Or via the Steam discussion📢[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3073580/discussions/

[b]How to support Aquatic Store Simulator?[/b]
The easiest way is to share your opinion of our game with others on Steam or among your friends. Thank you very much💗

notes.title: 🐡 Time Update! ⏰
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mXV-qlNmawI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Hello Aquatic fans😌🐠[/h2]

[h3]The new update is HERE🔥[/h3]

🔹 Added the ability to stop time! Many players requested this feature. Now, when there is a lot going on, you can stop time at any moment, new customers will not come, and you can calmly do whatever you want (remember that fish will not need food, they will not die, but they will also not reproduce or grow).

🔹 The long-awaited mechanic of placing plants in other decorations has been added. Yes, now you can set, for example, a stone as static and stick a plant on top of it. All plants now have the option of attaching them to other items that are set as static/placed in the substrate/placed in the aquarium background. Even more possibilities for your creativity!

🔹 When shopping in the store, you can add items to your favourites, which will make them easier to find later. There is also a new tab in the store that displays all your favourite items.

🔹 A new panel has been added to the management tablet, with a bank section where you can take out a loan that you will repay in instalments. This can make it easier to get started, but you always have to be careful with banks!


[h2] 🛍️  Fixes: 🏪
[/h2]

🔹 Sometimes, the restocker would put empty boxes in the restock room, taking up space. After loading the game, this will be fixed automatically, and empty boxes will always end up in the bin.

🔹 Fixed an important bug that blocked progress when the player threw away the bucket while pouring water into the aquarium/using the sink. This is no longer possible. Thank you for your reports!

🔹 Fixed so that customers and employees will no longer move free-standing decorations when walking (meaning they will no longer be pushed into cabinets from where they could not be removed!).

🔹 The restocker carrying boxes will no longer push the player while walking.

🔹 Many restocker fixes.

🔹 We have increased the chances that coral will fragment at the end of the day in the fragmentation aquarium.

🔹 Minor UI fixes.

⤵️⤵️⤵️

[b]How to contact us with bugs?
Do it via discord 📢[/b]
https://discord.gg/76N77uHWkc

[b]Or via the Steam discussion📢[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3073580/discussions/

[b]How to support Aquatic Store Simulator?[/b]
The easiest way is to share your opinion of our game with others on Steam or among your friends. Thank you very much💗

notes.title: Storage Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Aquatic store fans! 💦🐠

🐡 We have prepared an update for you to mark the start of the sale. Without further ado, let's get started! 🔥 [/h2]

[previewyoutube=sq_wgfclvCw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New stuff 🆕[/h3]

[*] A new shop room has been added to the game: 🌟 [b]Restockroom[/b] 🌟 This is a room that we can buy to unlock space for putting away cartons of goods. The same room is used by the restocker who will put the cartons on the shelves using them.

[*] You can have the restocker carry the newly purchased boxes to the restockroom cabinets, which improves the organisation of the shop.

[*] The restockroom has also been given an aquarium for coral reproduction. An ideal place to breed and grow corals, which you can then use in your aquariums or sell in the shop.

[*]added coral food for use in the coral reproduction aquarium

[*]added new achievement 

[h3]Fixes 🔧[/h3]

[*]fixed bug that sometimes, when the day was over, all customers left it was not possible to close the shop and move on to the next day. This is now fixed and if someone had such a bug, it will fix itself

[*]fixed the problem of the annoying repeating sound when a shopper was putting plants in the till

[*]fixed the problem that sometimes, when catching a fish, it would not appear in the net, even though it was actually there and had to be thrown back into the aquarium

[*]fixed problem where sometimes a player could not click on an item or pick anything up. From now on, this error will no longer happen

[*]Giving less change to customers while on the second checkout correctly counts towards the shop's final statistic of the day

[*]Fixed bug that it was possible to interact with the tablet and the time change table with the decoration in hand, which caused the cursor and the camera to be blocked; this is now fixed, and everything works as it should

[*]Corrected bug that the police officer did not come to insert the fine when using the second extra cash register. From now on, the police officer will respond correctly to theft from both

[b]If you still haven't tried Aquatic Store, maybe it's time to get it:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073580/Aquatic_Store_Simulator/

[b]How to contact us with bugs?
Do it via discord 📢[/b]
https://discord.gg/76N77uHWkc

[b]Or via the Steam discussion📢[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3073580/discussions/

[b]How to support Aquatic Store Simulator?[/b]
The easiest way is to share your opinion of our game with others on Steam or among your friends. Thank you very much💗

notes.title: Aquatic Store Simulator - Police and Labels Major Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Aquatic store fans,[/b]

[h3]Today we have prepared for you something bigger, [b]Police and Labels update[/b]. Below you can watch a trailer from the update and check the changelog.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=tq_8oOVr_F4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Changelog:[/b][/h3]

[list]

[u][b]WHAT'S NEW:[/b][/u]

[*] There is a new sign above the entrance to the store! From now on you can name your store and modify the name.

[*] Shop labels have been added to the game with which you can decorate your store. You can add descriptions and icons to make it easier to understand what is in the store.

[*] A short-change mechanic has been added when spending money to customers. You may underspend your customers, but be careful. If you overdo it, you will face… consequences!

[u][b]FIXES:[/b][/u]

[*] Fixed bug where restocker sometimes got stuck while working

[*] Fixed issue with customers and employees getting stuck on each other while walking around the store. Now this won't happen anymore, NPCs pass through each other at such moments, so they will never block each other again

[*] Fixed a bug with the restocker that did not want to use boxes with items purchased that appeared on the table

[*] Fixed that fish in aquariums became a little smaller after loading the game, now they remember their size correctly

[*] Fixed the problem that it was very rare to be able to pick up an item after it appeared at the checkout, which made it impossible to serve the customer. Now everything works properly

[*] Lots of smaller fixes

[/list]

[h3][b]Here are some new screenshots:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156822/71b1b56ac72d159d6535d778b334e1ff6de3434f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156822/61ff86dfccf0429f86bdf6e3d8a14921e2aa08b9.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073580/Aquatic_Store_Simulator/

Enjoy,
FreeMind

notes.title: Major new content Update
notes.content:
Welcome Aquatic Store fans,

Today we have prepared [b]some goodies[/b]. We have just uploaded a [u][b]Major update adding a lot of new content[/b][/u].

[h3]1. To celebrate the Farmer's Life Daily Deal[/h3] (best price ever), we have a complete sale of FreeMind games. If you don't have Farmer's Life yet, you can get it cheaper in a bundle ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46913/Farmer_in_Aquatic_Store/]LINK[/url])

[h3]2. We've announced 3 new games:[/h3]
🤖[b]Cyber ​​Farmer[/b]- a brand new awesome "neo-farmer" game ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461890/Cyber_Farmer]link[/url])

🍞 [b]New Farmer's Life DLC[/b] ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468940/Farmers_Life_Spread_the_Bread_DLC/]link[/url])

🛠️[b]New House Builder DLC[/b] ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348130/House_Builder__Deconstruction_DLC]link[/url])

[h3]3. Updates to our games:[/h3] Aquarist, Snow Plowing Simulator, House Builder or ServiceIT

[h2][u]But let's get to the most important thing, which is what we've included in our latest update to Aquatic Store Simulator:[/u][/h2]

[previewyoutube=isGVrSE2gzk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Changelog:[/b][/h3]

- A new employee has been added to the game! The restocker will help move items across shelves and clean empty boxes. Managing your store will become more enjoyable!

- The store has a new place, especially for two additional small aquariums.

- Leveling up the store is easier

- New tablet for employee management with a refreshed UI

- Added new fish and decorations to obtain 14 new fish, 1 background and 3 decorations!

- Improved mechanics of thermometers, previously they were useless because we already saw the temperature on the heater during setting, and now to see these values you need a thermometer, otherwise a description appears that it is missing

- New filter mechanics! Now you also need to take care of the level of water filtration in the aquariums to keep the fish happy. 3 new filters added. Each filter in the game has a new parameter describing the water filtering power, and you need to make sure that the filters you put in fit your aquarium. In this way we would like to add more realism to the game!

- Fishgiver works a little faster

- It's easier to make money by selling things off store shelves

 Aquariums show information about their capacity already in the store

- Now the earned money is displayed correctly in the window at the end of the day (some sources of income were omitted, such as the sale of excess fish, etc.)

- The range of actions has been increased, i.e. each action can be performed from further away. Pick up trash from a greater distance, feed the fish from a greater distance, or use an item on the aquarium or store shelves

- Fixed the problem that sometimes items could sink to the floor, now this is no longer possible

- Fixed a bug that when you selected a large item in the store and bought a box of them, you paid more than you should have

- Fixed a bug that when you entered the inspection of a fish that was supposed to give birth to a fish, new fish no longer appeared. Now it is fixed and the fish will breed

- Improved fish breeding system! Now you can obtain larger specimens through appropriate breeding! fish that are born take on the level of their mother fish. I.e. if we have a group of fish and all of them have the maximum level 6, the new fish that will be born will automatically have level 6 and will therefore be able to grow just as big!tomatycznie będzie miała 6 poziom i przez to będzie mogła urosnąć tak samo większa!

- Fixed a bug where catching a fish with a net resulted in resetting its level and name. Now this data is remembered correctly

- The smallmouth bass fish became invisible in some aquariums in the water, now it is correct

- From now on you can place much larger decorations in aquariums. You can decorate aquariums in an easier way and make nicer creations! (old on the left, new on the right)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156822/da4ec4947d2314cc9ef495023208817b59d76e09.png[/img]


 Enjoy playing,
FreeMind

notes.title: Christmas Update and Road Map!
notes.content:
🎄Christmas time has come❗️

[h3]The Christmas update has arrived in the game! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156822/942a6ecbf65cde4948640f049be3f00669c70aee.png[/img]


📢Get a gift🎁 and get 15 new decorations that will allow you to create a real Christmas aquarium! You can also sell them to customers who will be wearing Santa hats during the Christmas time.

Watch update trailer here: [previewyoutube=HwE2TCAeS0E;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3][u][b]🎁Changelog🎁[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved end of day window. Now it contains more information, is more readable and nicer.
[*] Improved mechanics that automatic feeders can now be refilled at any time and only pay for the missing food.
[*] Fixed a bug where it was possible to catch a dead and a live fish at the same time, which resulted in the fish being wasted. Now it works properly.
[*] Fixed the problem that Japanese carps could not be picked up in the shop.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to enter fish mode while inspecting the aquarium.
[*] Fixed bug that it was impossible to change the water to freshwater in large aquariums when there was no soil inside
[*] Sound effects settings in the game options did not mute all sounds effects, now it works properly.
[*] UI fixes in: quest descriptions, in the store, item descriptions and more.
[/list]

[h3][u][b]🎅Roadmap🎅[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156822/8800085bd3ccb7e177725af858cc55dc8173a2ac.png[/img]

[u][b]In each update, new fish and decorations will be available.[/b][/u]

1.
[list]
[*] New employee: a staff member who stocks shelves and removes empty boxes.
[*] Adding space for 2 additional small aquariums.
[/list]
2.
[list]
[*] Police event: the ability to give less change to customers. But be careful, the police might notice, and... you'll find out what happens!
[*] Create your own shop sign above the entrance.
[*] Animal protection foundation will check if the fish are in good condition.
[*] Enhanced store customization with ceiling hangers, allowing you to label parts of the shop yourself.
[/list]
3.
[list]
[*] New storage room where you can store boxes with items.
[*] A scanner and tablet to make buying items easier.
[*] Breeding aquarium for coral reefs.
[/list]
4.
[list]
[*] Licenses for new themed fish sets
[*] Players will be able to manage timed events to attract more customers and boost sales.
[*] Customers will have the option to buy entire aquariums.
[/list]
5.
[list]
[*] A brand-new location, even bigger than the current one, capable of housing larger fish and marine creatures!
[/list]

[b][h3]More future updates will come after that.[/h3][/b]

notes.title: Aquatic Store Simulator Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Changelog:

-A second garbage bin added at the back of the store

-Fixed bug that it was impossible to replace blackwater from large aquariums near the wall (now you can correctly replace blackwater with clean water by clicking the water management device on the wall)

-Fixed a bug that prevented access to the large (715l) aquarium in the store after loading the game

-Improved size of items at the checkout. Some items have been enlarged to make them easier to grab (e.g. seashells) and some have been reduced to fit easier in the basket (e.g. some decorations such as a castle). This should make scanning easier and more enjoyable

-Fixed a bug that caused some players to start a new game with all items already unlocked in the game

-Client pathing has been improved, now there is no chance that clients will get blocked permanently and they should better recover from situations when they get blocked

-Fixed a bug when, while catching a fish with a net, the player pressed the left mouse button again and the caught fish was thrown out of the map

-Fixed a bug where throwing trash into the trash bin was sometimes counted twice

-Fixed a bug that two large oblong wall aquariums were incorrectly saved when set as blackwater

-Minor fixes and improvements

notes.title: Aquatic Store Simulator Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Changelog:

-fixed a bug that caused the player, after closing the game, to no longer have access to unlocked items that he received as gifts for the number of items sold. Now it works correctly and after you load your game, you will regain access to all the items you have acquired

-Fixed a bug that prevented the game from being paused after selling the aquarium

-Improved position of automatic feeders placed on aquarium walls

-Getting to store level 3 has been made a little easier

-Improved size and arrangement of items in the hand-held cardboard, thanks to which almost all items in the game now no longer protrude outside the cardboard

-Minor game-supporting fixes

notes.title: Aquatic Store Simulator Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Changelog:

-Improved description of the dirt removal quest. Now it is clearly written to remove dirt from the walls and floor

-Improved description of the current quest to make it easier to understand what it takes to level up the shop

-Fixed a bug when changing the game language in the settings during the tutorial, after returning to the game the wrong task was displayed

-Fixed a bug where sometimes when throwing an item into the trash it would not be removed correctly, resulting in you being unable to pick up anything else

-Throwing trash from a distance is now also available on the gamepad

-It is no longer possible to throw an object into the gap on both sides of the work table, from which it was impossible to take small objects out. Now there are two nice flowers standing there

-When setting the price of an item on the shelf, you can confirm it with a space or enter

-Improved size and arrangement of items in the hand-held cardboard, thanks to which many items no longer protrude outside the cardboard

-Minor localization fixes in English

Thank you for your feedback! Thanks to it, we can quickly fix any bugs you encounter and we know what to add to the game in the future! We're glad you like the game.
